sources.title: GLM-5.3 - Overview - Z.AI DEVELOPER DOCUMENT
sources.snippet: Overview GLM-5.3 is Z.ai's latest flagship model, delivering comprehensive advancements in complex software engineering and agent capabilities. It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2, with all improvements driven by post-training. sources.title: GLM-5.3: Frontier Coding with Emergent Cyber Capabilities - z.ai
sources.snippet: Today we are releasing GLM-5.3. It uses the same base model as GLM-5.2 — every gain comes from post-training. Compared with GLM-5.2, it is much better at complex coding and long-horizon tasks: Stronger Coding: GLM-5.3 is the most capable open-weights model for coding, with a 50% improvement over GLM-5.2 on our in-house Z.ai Code Bench.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash is Z.ai's first natively multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. It is a 320B Mixture-of-Experts model with 18B active parameters, built for coding, agentic work, and visual tasks, and released under the MIT License.

sources.title: Z.ai shares surge 8% after releasing new AI model running only on ...
sources.snippet: Dive Deeper: GLM-5.3-Flash is described as a lower-cost iteration of Z.ai's flagship model and is claimed to operate entirely on homegrown semiconductors. The company states that all online requests for the model run through hardware built in China, with the August 20 release under the code name Ox Alpha.
